The Approach

One integrated practice.

Traditional Chinese Medicine, somatic healing, and nervous system regulation are not separate disciplines here. They are one practice.

Many women begin with health optimization. Longevity, hormonal balance, sleep, the physical foundation underneath everything else.

From there, the work often moves deeper, into the nervous system and the patterns living in the body.

A session moves between the physical, the emotional, and the energetic, following whatever is asking to be met.

This is the foundation for how we work together, whether in a single consultation or in longer mentorship.

See how the work unfolds

Meet Angela Le, DACM

A way of working that belongs to no single tradition.

Dr. Le is a Doctor of Acupuncture and Chinese Medicine, in practice since 2001, and one of the country’s first integrative fertility acupuncturists.

She trained in a seventy-four-generation Taoist lineage at Yo San University, and has guided thousands of women through health challenges and major reproductive life transitions.

What emerged from decades of study, clinical practice, and her own healing is a way of working that belongs to no single tradition and draws on all of them.
